data.title: 伊内丝 · 幕布之后
data.description: 幕布遮住了外面的喧闹。她回身向你伸手，等你跟上才低声说，另一条路只有你们知道。
data.action: 掀开侧幕，回望并向镜头伸手
data.lighting: 舞台余光与暗处形成层次
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Backstage in the dramatic, shadow-filled theater wings, Ines peeks from behind heavy velvet stage curtains, watching the vibrant, energetic performance on stage. Beams of blue and white spotlight light spill into the gloom, casting sharp silhouettes of stage scenery, rigging equipment, and her own poised, observing figure.
